checks: For k≥2, feasibility is exactly q≥k−1, so q>0 and the equal vector has strictly positive entries. Padding it with a zero preserves the law and gives an unequal feasible vector at count q+1. Strict equalization implies A_{k,q+1}<A_{k,q}.

The scaled Gamma(q,1) threshold has mean k−1 and variance (k−1)^2/q. Outside the Chebyshev exceptional event the moving sign event is sandwiched by the two deterministic thresholds. Conditioning on E_0 shows X−E_0 has no atom at k−1, so the bounds coalesce as epsilon decreases to zero after q tends to infinity.

Every finite minimum exceeds its limit, since the next minimum is strictly smaller and at least the limit. The equal vectors provide the required approximating sequence. For k=1, all residual coefficients vanish, including the empty list, and the two independent unit exponentials have equal probabilities of either strict order.

Conditioning on X gives the ordinary tail minus e^s times its e^(−X)-weighted tail. Substitution u=2x gives the factor 2^(−k) and tail at 2s. Inserting the finite gamma tail formula yields the stated summands. Exact rational arithmetic after removing e^(−(k−1)) gives 1/2, 5/4 and 27/8 at k=1,2,3 respectively.

summary: The explicit gamma probability is the infimum over finite feasible lists. It is strictly below every finite-list probability for k≥2, and attained by every feasible list for k=1.
